title: Harbor: our Switch emulator, in development
body: Harbor is OpenPak's Nintendo Switch emulator, built on Eden and maintained by OpenPak as its own project. It runs the Switch system menu and games on a computer, and it is meant to pair with the OpenPak Switch network, the same accounts, friends and online services a real Switch uses today. Status: in active development, with its OpenPak integration being rebuilt on upstream Eden and not yet tested title by title. A game starting in Harbor does not yet mean its online play works, so the real console remains where OpenPak is live today.
footer: OpenPak Networks — built in the open.
